prompt_head:
Job: Configuration Specialist II at CentralReach
<requirements>
- (required) 1–3 years of experience in a technical configuration, implementation, or SaaS opera

paragraphs.text: I am applying for the Configuration Specialist II role because the posting asks for translating business and implementation requirements into backend system configurations. In a previous role I constructed database-layer automated data validation pipelines that eliminated 98% of transactional and invoicing errors. I am a Systems Architect focused on AI automation and agent engineering, with 4+ years of experience building full-stack platforms, business automation tools, and AI agent workflows.

The posting asks for provisioning and configuring customer accounts across internal systems. I architected and deployed linkme-intops, an operations CRM module built with React and TypeScript on Cloudflare Workers, which gives staff a dedicated interface for high-value subscription accounts. I also designed integration blueprints and live demo environments to reliably onboard high-value enterprise clients onto the core platform. For AI rule settings and workflows, the posting asks for careful configuration work. I built Job Fit Agent, a LangGraph agent that drafts tailored documents behind a human approval step.

The gap is domain. I have no experience with autism or IDD care software or Applied Behavior Analysis therapy, and I will not claim otherwise. To close it, I would spend my first month with your Implementation team learning how ABA workflows run from intake to billing, and I would document the configuration tickets that take the longest to resolve. Before I change any backend rule, I would confirm it with the people who use it every day.
If translating clinical requirements into clean backend configurations is the job you need filled, I would like to talk. Could we set up a short call this week or next?
